conviction_note: The H1 beat against the company plan is close to mechanical (Q2 USD/JPY averaged 159.25 against a 150 plan, and Q1 already made 535億 of operating profit at that rate against an implied Q2 plan of 509億), but the bar is the IFIS FY OP consensus of 2,286億, already 4.9% above the 2,180億 guide. Fanuc kept its H2 FX conservative last year and in July, and a raise that fell short of consensus cost 14.3% on 2026-08-03, so the guide outcome is two-sided: p_up 54 on a 5.5% scale gives +0.44, against an impact_sum of +1.6 whose positives are mostly public or inferred.
bar: IFIS consensus FY3/27 operating profit 228,628百万円 (ordinary 277,226, sales 975,681) against the company guide of 218,000 set 2026-07-31: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6954 (as of 2026-10-22). My estimate: H1 OP ~1,100億 against a 1,044億 plan; FY raised to ~2,240-2,300億 if H2 FX stays at 150/175, which is roughly at the bar (print_vs_bar about -0.5%).
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5%, unchanged (as of 2026-10-22, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from baseline). 信用倍率 21.41 (baseline; kabutan shows the same 21.41倍 on https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6954): a crowded margin long, so a disappointing guide would still find sellers. No options, no skew. Run-up 20d -8.94%, 5d -8.42%. Stock is down from 6,250 on 10/14 to ~5,466 intraday on 10/23, during a market-wide AI/semiconductor de-risking (Nikkei -1,713 on 10/22). The 500億 buyback that was in the market 9/1-9/17 ended on 9/17.

findings.finding: Fanuc's own Q1 presentation sets the 2Q-4Q FX plan at 150 JPY/USD and 175 JPY/EUR, and Q1 operating profit was 535億 at 159.49/185.39. Q2 averaged 159.25 USD and 183.21 EUR (Yahoo daily closes), so Q2 operating profit should clear the implied Q2 plan of 509億 (H1 plan 1,044 less Q1 535), and H1 should beat the 1,044億 plan by roughly 5%. Yaskawa moved its own H2 FX assumption to 155/180 at its 10/9 print. Whether the FY raise clears the 2,286億 consensus depends on whether Fanuc lifts its H2 FX (EUR is now back at 175) or keeps it conservative, as it did at Q2 last year (140 USD assumed for H2) and at Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same line at Q1 (2026-07-31): FY OP raised 2,122->2,180 against a higher consensus and the stock fell 14.31% (7,135->6,114) despite orders beating by 400-500億 (Fisco, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6954&b=n202608030325). At the FY print (2026-04-24) +15.98%. At Q2 last year (2025-10-31) FY OP was raised 159.5->175.9 (+10.3%) with H2 FX at 140/165, and the stock rose +5.11%.
findings.why_not_priced: The FX gap is public and analysts know it; IFIS FY OP consensus already sits 4.9% above the guide. Only the H1 beat is close to mechanical, and the FY outcome is two-sided. What is not priced is how far the expectation has reset: the stock is 23% below the 7,135 it reached into the Q1 print and has fallen 12.5% since 10/14 on market-wide AI de-risking, not on anything company-specific. If the market expected a large raise, the stock would not have fallen into the print alongside the Nikkei.
findings.independence: Peer document: Yaskawa raised its H2 FX to 155/180 and its sales guide at its 10/9 print (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6506&b=n202610130281). Fanuc's own Q2 FY2025 tanshin shows the conservative-FX habit (H2 at 140/165): https://www.fanuc.co.jp/ja/ir/announce/pdf/2025/financialresult202509.pdf

findings.finding: Demand indicators for Fanuc's Q2 orders are strong: JMTBA machine-tool orders for September were 2,232億 (+60.4% y/y, the 15th straight y/y rise). Fanuc's CNC goes into those machines. Fanuc's Q1 orders were 2,819億 (+36.9%; FA +63.8%, China +50.9%), against 2,310億 of sales, a book-to-bill of 1.22. Yaskawa's Jun-Aug orders were a record (+38% y/y), above consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At Q1 orders beat consensus by 400-500億 and the stock still fell 14.3% on the guide, so this name has looked through an orders beat when the guide underwhelmed. Yaskawa rose +1.2% (4,783->4,840) on record orders despite an OP guide cut.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: JMTBA data has been out since 10/9 and Fanuc's Q1 orders are public. The residual is that the orders number and backlog support an H2 raise, and the stock fell through the period these data came out. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Fanuc Q1 orders, a different document: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260730504187.pdf; Yaskawa orders: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6506&b=n202610130382

findings.finding: The expectation going into the print has reset. The stock fell from 6,250 (10/14) to ~5,466 (10/23 intraday) in a market-wide AI/semiconductor de-risking (Nikkei -1,713 on 10/22, the lowest since 7/30), with no Fanuc-specific news. On the real release dates, the last three Q2 prints moved +4.19% (2023-10-31), +3.32% (2024-10-25) and +5.11% (2025-10-31), each after a flat-to-negative 5-day run-in.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Computed from Yahoo daily closes on the real 15:30 release dates (kabutan finance page dates): Q2 prints +4.19, +3.32, +5.11. All 12 prints since 2023-10: +4.19, -0.35, -3.43, +2.93, +3.32, +0.06, +1.29, +5.00, +5.11, -0.81, +15.98, -14.31.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference and a seasonal pattern on three cases, so it is sized small. The drawdown is index-driven (CTA selling of AI names, per kabutan), so it lowered the bar the guide has to clear without any change in Fanuc's fundamentals. Against it: 信用倍率 21.4 means leveraged longs are still there.

findings.finding: Fanuc finished its 500億 buyback (authorised 4/24 to run to 2027-04-30) seven months early: 4.287m shares for 251.7億 between 9/1 and 9/17, and nothing as of 6/30. That leaves capacity, and a precedent of accelerating returns, for a new authorisation alongside the H1 results and interim dividend (payout policy 60%). I found no sourced precedent of a Fanuc buyback announced at a Q2 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No Q2-print buyback in the record I could reach (H1 FY3/26 cash flow shows 6.65億 of buybacks, so none in that half). The April 2026 authorisation came with the FY print, which rose +15.98%, though the guide also moved then.
findings.why_not_priced: The early completion is public. A new authorisation is speculative and has no precedent I could source, so this is a small option-like positive. If the market expected one, the stock would not have drifted 7% lower since the buying stopped on 9/17 (5,852 on 9/18).

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: very likely an upward FY revision; the bar is IFIS FY OP 2,286億 against a guide of 2,180, and the size turns on the H2 FX assumption. Returns: interim dividend per the 60% payout (mechanical); the buyback finished early, and a new one is possible but has no sourced precedent. New-year guide: n/a at H1. Quarter: Q1 ordinary-profit progress against the H1 plan was 50.6%, against 47.8% and 43.4% in the two prior years, so H1 is tracking above plan.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive against a mildly negative priced lean (-0.22, driven by the margin overhang) and a -8.9% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY raise above 2,286億 with FX lifted, plus a new buyback; I looked for both. The strongest negative is a repeat of July: a raise short of consensus, with leveraged retail long. That two-sidedness keeps p_up at 54.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rules 1-2 concern negatives built on public 月次/progress series and a negative tilt, and this file's findings are positive and rest on the guide; open question 4 (run-in) is noted, and the 5-day decline here is the mirror case, already sized small
